purpose: Example Azure OpenAI deployment configuration for synthetic Northstar typed-plan proposals across two equal-information evaluation arms.

api.schemaEnforcement: Full supplied Plan JSON Schema and Pydantic validation locally; JSON mode is NOT strict structured output. Preserve dictionary and discriminated-union constraints.
api.rationale: Learn recommends Responses for Azure OpenAI. Documented v1 Chat Completions supports this narrow single-response JSON-plan adapter without unsupported schema transformations.
api.requestPolicy: Exactly one nonstreamed text completion, n=1, store=false, max_completion_tokens includes reasoning tokens. No tools, arbitrary URL forwarding, redirects, automatic retries or paid repair loops.
api.modelSelectionGate: Verify selected version supports system messages, JSON mode, store=false, and max_completion_tokens; capture documented service-enforced context/token limits and exact response model string before configuring.

identity.roleScope: Exact approved Azure OpenAI resource only; separately approve any new role assignment.
identity.tokenProvider: Explicit injected async callable only; no DefaultAzureCredential, ambient login, secrets lookup or token audience fallback.
identity.deploymentRoles: Resource creation and model deployment require separately approved provisioning identity/permissions; the inference User role does not grant creation. No role assignment is staged for execution.
identity.documentationDifference: Current v1 lifecycle and structured-output guides use https://ai.azure.com/.default. The REST Chat reference still lists cognitiveservices.azure.com. Follow the v1 guide's configured scope, verify actual approved access later, and never silently switch audience.

budget.costFormula: maximum inference cost = max_requests * (max_input_tokens * input_price_per_million + max_output_tokens * output_price_per_million) / 1000000; total authorized cost must also cover separately estimated provisioning, provisioned-throughput commitments, networking, storage and diagnostics if selected.
budget.inputBound: Reserve the selected model's complete documented service-enforced context window as max_input_tokens for EVERY request. This deliberately conservative bound includes message framing; byte limits are transport limits, never claimed to be a tokenizer. No dispatch without reviewed model/version capability evidence and a cap large enough for one maximum reservation.
budget.pricingPolicy: User must choose positive verified upper-bound uncached input and all-completion-token prices in one currency for the actual model/version/region/SKU. No invented prices, discounts, cache savings or provisioned-throughput assumptions.
budget.ledger: One private approval-wide SQLite ledger shared by both arms/processes. BEGIN IMMEDIATE check/reserve before send; UUID per attempt; durable accounting survives restart. Bind ledger location, all limits/pricing and artifact context into approval digest. Never delete/reset/copy the ledger during an approval.
budget.unknownOutcomes: Timeout, cancellation, HTTP failure, malformed envelopes and missing/untrusted usage retain the maximum reservation. Invalid plans remain paid. Only validated counts from the pinned model may reconcile cost; call count is never refunded.

approvalRequirements: Exact demo Azure subscription resource/deployment and expected response model version; real target identifiers stay in private local configuration outside repository and synchronized folders.
Exact artifact/configuration/context revision digests, including shared ledger location and all token/request/byte/time/pricing limits.
Separate explicit operations for resource/deployment creation, any role assignments, paid-plan-proposal and teardown; staging grants none.
Verified availability/quota and dated model capability/pricing evidence; user-chosen request cap and total operational cost cap in a selected currency.
Explicit absolute expiry, TTL, teardown owner, exact owned-resource inventory and teardown mechanism. No inference past expiry.
Separate approval for later read-only cloud discovery/login if required; no discovery was performed while preparing this example.

teardown.mechanism: After exact approval, remove only resources/deployments/roles created and owned by the deployment. Do not alter shared capacity, existing resources or unrelated roles. Preserve sanitized receipts and ledger until final cost reconciliation.

implementation.identity: provider='azure-openai-v1-chat'; model_version is the configured expected response model string
implementation.evidence: Task-local last_receipt; request_receipt(request_id); approval-wide budget_snapshot(). Receipts contain hashes, safe outcome codes, counts and cost only, never prompts, output text, tokens or private thoughts.
implementation.tests: Synthetic httpx.MockTransport UNIT tests only; no actual inference, cloud discovery, provisioning, login, role changes or secrets lookup.

sources.supports: v1 endpoints, Chat support, Responses recommendation, runtime role and ai.azure.com token scope
REST Chat request fields, max_completion_tokens including reasoning, n=1, output and usage contract
json_object, explicit JSON instruction, finish_reason checks and no schema guarantee
Strict output distinction and local typed validation; current Plan is not silently transformed
Inference User role versus separate resource/deployment creation permissions

limitations: No model/version/region/SKU/resource is selected and no availability, quota or actual price has been verified.
No selected-model context ceiling, exact returned model string or paid inference has been observed.
No private configured target, currently valid paid approval, deployed resource, assigned role or teardown guard exists in this example.

Application-side ledger is not an Azure billing control and cannot account for calls made outside this approved adapter. Dedicated owned scope and external operational controls require separate review.
